title: What Happens To Your Body After 24 Hours With No Sleep?
sources: NIH Sleep Foundation: after 24 hours awake, cognitive impairment equals 0.10% blood alcohol — legally drunk
Neuron journal: sleep clears adenosine and metabolic waste via the glymphatic system; skipping this causes toxic buildup
PNAS: amygdala becomes 60% more reactive after one sleepless night — emotional responses become uncontrolled
Lancet case reports: fatal familial insomnia — hereditary condition that prevents sleep and kills within 18 months

lines.text: After sixteen hours without sleep, you are legally impaired.
Your brain is performing like someone who is drunk.
Adenosine, a chemical waste product, is now flooding your neurons.
Your prefrontal cortex — the part that makes decisions — goes quiet.
Your amygdala, the panic center, becomes sixty percent more reactive.
You start seeing things that aren't there.
lines.caps: You start *seeing | things that | aren't there

lines.text: Micro-sleeps hit without warning — your eyes open but your brain is offline.
Immune cells drop by seventy percent.
Your body enters the same stress state as surviving an attack.
There is a disease called fatal familial insomnia.
It stops you from ever sleeping again, and kills you in eighteen months.
lines.caps: It *stops you | ever *sleeping | kills you | in *eighteen months
